external_component_definition: Cargo package from cargo metadata with non-null source. Workspace path packages are excluded from component-revocation trials.

external_substrate.selection_reason: Real protected external Rust workspace with many independently declared component crates, shared/transitive third-party dependencies, a locked dependency graph, and reproducible cargo metadata/build checks.

source_acquisition.build_check: cargo check --locked for all six frozen target packages in one invocation
source_acquisition.git_fetch: git init + fetch exact commit with depth 1 + detached checkout
source_acquisition.source_tree_binding: SHA-256 over target Cargo.toml plus recursive target crate files, root Cargo.toml, and Cargo.lock
